name: Palmhaven Town
chat: Welcome to Palmhaven Town, where the sun is free and so is everything else, on paper.
My yacht is parked behind my other yacht.
The bank here has no windows and no doors. You just know.
Leader Marina trains her Water team in the lagoon every morning.
Mt. Cinderpeak grumbles when the market drops. Lately it grumbles a lot.
Try the coconut. It is the only thing here that pays tax.
The Marina is just along the promenade. Every boat there is registered somewhere else.
The Offshore Bank has no windows on the inside.

props.say: Harbour Office: “Your money is safe here. Mostly from you.”
